scope: All release-candidate files and fallback Git blobs; changed files manually reviewed
credential_scans: No exact configured-key or high-confidence OpenRouter/GitHub/AWS/private-key/credential-URL matches; no secret values logged
content_review: Only demo code, focused tests, README and new test/demo output; no private financial records, confidential assignment documents, private conversations or unrelated files found
syntax_check: New Python files parse with Python 3.8 grammar; runtime checks used Python 3.13.12 only
limitations: Pattern scans and manual content review cannot guarantee absence of every possible form of sensitive data. Demo is synthetic and the model response is a historical replay, not new model performance.
